cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: Follow the harbour from the Opera House to waterfront neighbourhoods, then make time for Sydney's ocean beaches and coastal walks.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Discover a city of laneway cafés, galleries and neighbourhood markets, with a waterfront skyline stretching toward Port Phillip Bay.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: Explore Tokyo one neighbourhood at a time, from Shinjuku's skyline and lively food streets to quiet gardens and traditional temples.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Wander historic lanes, pause in peaceful temple gardens and take in the hillside setting of Kiyomizu-dera in Japan's former capital.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: Discover the towers, stone galleries and intricate carvings of Angkor Wat, a monumental temple complex near Siem Reap.

temples.name: Borobudur, Indonesia
temples.description: Explore the sculpted reliefs and bell-shaped stupas of this Buddhist temple, set amid the green landscapes of Central Java.

beaches.name: Bondi Beach, Australia
beaches.description: Find golden sand, rolling surf and a lively seaside neighbourhood at Bondi, with ocean views along the coastal path toward Coogee.

beaches.name: Whitehaven Beach, Australia
beaches.description: Head to the Whitsundays for bright white sand and turquoise water, where Whitehaven Beach curves along the shores of Whitsunday Island.
